audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 3, 5 and 6 disagree with the already-applied mirror.
audit.why: Mirror (gragas__vayne) landed Skill / Gragas / Gragas / Gragas / Gragas / Gragas / Vayne. This file had Gragas / Gragas / Gragas / Skill / Gragas / Skill / Gragas. Level 1 is a coinflip before Barrel Roll's 80-mana 10s poke pattern is repeatable; Levels 4-5 and the first-item mark are his because Drunken Rage's damage reduction and a 14s Body Slam stun beat one Blade of the Ruined King; the two-item mark is yours because percent-max-HP true damage ignores everything he builds.
audit.corrected: Chart: Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Vayne, with ratings and the contradicted whys rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[6].why was boilerplate about carry threat instead of naming the spike that owns the stage.
audit.why: The two-item stage is defined by Silver Bolts' percent-max-HP true damage against his resistances and by Final Hour making Tumble invisible, which is what dodges a telegraphed Explosive Cask.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns and Barrel Roll's self-detonation were never stated, and the knockback direction on Explosive Cask was not made actionable.
audit.why: Body Slam is 600 range on 14s at rank 1 falling only to 12s — the post-Body-Slam window is the entire lane. Barrel Roll explodes on its own after 4 seconds and its potency grows, so standing in the cask is worse than eating an early detonation. Explosive Cask is a knockback, so where you stand decides whether the flip sends you home or into his tower.
audit.corrected: Fight in the 12-14s after Body Slam, never stand on a live cask, and position so a Cask flips you toward your own side.

audit.why: Happy Hour heals on every ability use, so Grievous Wounds matters — report[8] already prescribes Executioner's Calling early and breakdown.late already says anti-heal stays core.
audit.corrected: No edit needed; the anti-heal line is already present.

audit.why: Packet flagged "Drunken Rage's" as a probable wrong name. False positive — it is the correct W name in possessive form.

edits.before: Gragas out-ranges Vayne with Barrel Roll and his Drunken Rage autos chunk her while W reduces any return damage.
edits.after: At Level 1 Barrel Roll costs 80 mana on a 10s cooldown, so sidestepping it makes the first wave a coinflip.

edits.before: Around Levels 4-5 it's even skill — before his ult, Vayne can farm safely and trade the cooldown gaps.
edits.after: Through Levels 4-5 his Q slow plus a 14s Body Slam stun still deny every trade window you want.

edits.before: Gragas wins the Level 1-2 poke exchange outright — Barrel Roll (Q) outranges you and Drunken Rage empowered autos chunk you while his W damage reduction shrugs off any return fire. Just farm and dodge.
edits.after: Level 1 is a coinflip, then Gragas takes over — Barrel Roll (Q) reaches 850 past your 550 and Drunken Rage empowered autos chunk you while his W damage reduction shrugs off return fire.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay his: Body Slam (E) is a gap-closing stun, his Q slow kites your approaches, and at 6 Explosive Cask (R) can flip you into tower for a kill. The lone even beat is around Level 4 before his R is a threat, but respect the poke and walls.
edits.after: Levels 2-6 stay his: Body Slam (E) is a 14s gap-closing stun, his Q slow kites your approaches, and at 6 Explosive Cask (R) can flip you into tower for a kill. Your only opening is the 12-14s after he spends Body Slam, and only away from walls.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Gragas carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: Silver Bolts' percent-max-HP true damage melts his tank stats and Final Hour's invisible Tumbles dodge Explosive Cask.

edits.before: His engage. Condemn the follow-up. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Body Slam is 600 range and 14s at rank 1 — that gap is your only window.

edits.before: Gragas wastes Body Slam — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Barrel Roll detonates on its own after 4s — do not stand in it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Explosive Cask knocks back — stand so the flip pushes you home.
